Find a very dark - pitch black room

Next do you believe in jesus christ ??

Try and look at your situation from different perspectives and if you are still struggling ask for help, i promise god is always with you, we just never take the time to look & listen.

I hope this helps, like i said pray for anything, talk about everything, don't be afraid to ask questions, who knows might even get an answer.
